name: Tam Coc
provinceNote: From 1 July 2025, xã Ninh Hải sits inside phường Nam Hoa Lư, tỉnh Ninh Bình. Older listings still say xã Ninh Hải, tỉnh Hoa Lư, or Ninh Hai Commune, Hoa Lu District. The hamlet is thôn Văn Lâm.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A riverside village in Ninh Binh, where rowing boats take you through rice fields and limestone caves. Ride a sampan along the Ngo Dong River through three caves and back, about two hours, then eat crispy rice, mountain goat and nem Yen Mac. Suits most travellers; stay a night in Van Lam for a slower pace.

seoTitle: Tam Coc guide — sampan on the Ngo Dong, three caves, rice and karst
seoDescription: Sit in a sampan on sông Ngô Đồng and ride through three caves, rice and karst on either side. Sleep in thôn Văn Lâm. This boat is not the Tràng An ride.
intro: You sit low in a sampan on sông Ngô Đồng, rice at the gunwale and karst on both sides, and the rower takes you through hang Cả, hang Hai, and hang Ba. Tam Cốc means three caves. You board at bến thuyền Tam Cốc, at Đình Các in thôn Văn Lâm, and you come back to the same pier. The ride is about 2 hours out and back. The river has no banks. It is a channel between the fields, a tributary of sông Sào Khê that starts near đền Suối Tiên and meets sông Vạc near cầu Vũng Trắm. This is not the Sào Khê boat.

Sleep in thôn Văn Lâm when the sampan is the reason you came. Go to Ninh Bình when you want the Sào Khê boat, Hoa Lư, or the Hang Múa stair. Green and yellow paddies run beside this boat. The Tràng An towers, on the other river, rise about 200 m.

Chùa Bích Động is 2 km from the pier, three halls called Hạ, Trung, and Thượng, above a branch of the river and the rice. The old ranking calls it Nam thiên đệ nhị động. Đền Thái Vi is the same distance by road, or a walk off the boat.

The fields go from green to yellow, then to the silver of water on the paddies. Bicycles are common, with hire at most tourist points. After the boat, walk the fields. One of those walks is set at 18:30. The evening is the lanes, not a bar street. Eat cơm cháy, mountain goat, and nem Yên Mạc in the hamlet. A family day also sets cá rô Tổng Trường at midday, and that fish is also served in the city or the old capital.
gettingAround: Ga Ninh Bình is the station. Southbound, the kilometre column starts at Hà Nội and Ninh Bình is km 115. SE7 leaves Hà Nội at 06:00 and arrives at 08:16, 2 hours 16 minutes, or at 08:13, 2 hours 13 minutes. SE5 is 08:00–10:16, 2 hours 16 minutes. SE9 is 13:00–15:17, 2 hours 17 minutes. SE3 is 19:20–21:36, 2 hours 16 minutes. SE1 is 21:45–00:03 the next day, 2 hours 18 minutes. SE19 is listed beside these trains and is not on the Thống Nhất table.

Northbound, the kilometre column starts at Sài Gòn. Ninh Bình is at km 1611 and Hà Nội at km 1726, the same 115 km. SE8 leaves Ninh Bình at 13:59 and reaches Hà Nội at 16:20, on the day after the Sài Gòn departure, 2 hours 21 minutes on that leg. SE6 is 16:55–19:14, 2 hours 19 minutes. SE10 does not stop at Ninh Bình. SE4 is 02:14–04:36, 2 hours 22 minutes. SE2 is 03:24–05:42, 2 hours 18 minutes. From the station you still ride on to the pier at Đình Các.

The river is about 100 km by road from Hà Nội, and about 100 km from the center of Hà Nội on Quốc lộ 1A. Hà Nội to Ninh Bình by road is also given as 94 km, a different end. The pier is 7 km from phường Hoa Lư, the provincial centre, 7 km from Ninh Binh City, and about 7 km from thành phố Hoa Lư. It is 2 km from Quốc lộ 1 and 9 km from Tam Điệp. Phố cổ Hoa Lư is about 15–20 minutes from Tam Coc.

On the water, the higher combined ticket includes the electric shuttle. Without it you still take the sampan. Bích Động and Thái Vi are each 2 km from the pier. Thung Nắng, Thung Nham, and Hang Bụt are separate boats. The Tràng An ticket is a different row, on sông Sào Khê, and that boat stays in Ninh Bình.

interestsBody: After the boat, lunch in the hamlet is cơm cháy, mountain goat, and nem Yên Mạc. A family day also sets cá rô Tổng Trường at midday.

You board at Đình Các and ride sông Ngô Đồng through hang Cả, hang Hai, and hang Ba, with the rice changing color beside the boat. Bích Động, Thái Vi, and the Văn Lâm embroidery lane sit on the same day.

interestGroups.title: Dining and F&B
interestGroups.summary: Cơm cháy, goat, mountain snail, and nem Yên Mạc, eaten in the hamlet after the boat.
body: You eat in the hamlet. Restaurants at Tam Coc serve cơm cháy with thịt dê núi and with tim cật, and they serve dê nướng and five ốc núi plates. Lunch in the tourist area, or nearby, is cơm cháy, dê núi, and nem Yên Mạc. A Tam Coc day sets dê tái chanh, cơm cháy, and dê nướng at 11:45. A family day sets cá rô Tổng Trường with dê núi and cơm cháy at midday. That fish is also served in the city or the old capital.

The local list is fourteen plates: crisp rice, three goat plates, five mountain-snail plates, nem Yên Mạc, grilled perch, crab soup, and salted eggplant at Hang Bụt, and cá rô Tổng Trường. The snail comes out of the rock caves from April to August. Hill-goat cooking is also done in the city or the old capital.

blocks.heading: Văn Lâm embroidery
paragraphs: The lane is thôn Văn Lâm, in the middle of the Tam Coc–Bích Động site, beside sông Ngô Đồng. You watch the hand embroidery and you can try the stitch. Handbags, tablecloths, and decorative pictures are the goods, and a piece can take months or years. The work sits in the OCOP programme. The giỗ Tổ is the 20th of the first lunar month, and the solar date moves with the moon.

Two founding stories are told. One dates the craft to the 13th century, when Trần Thị Dung taught the stitch as Trần Thái Tông came to núi Vũ Lâm. The other dates it to the Đinh century, taught by Nguyễn Thị Sen. The combined ticket covers the boat, Thái Vi, Động Tiên, and Bích Động. The lane is a separate stop in the hamlet.

interestGroups.title: The sampan
interestGroups.summary: You board at Đình Các and ride sông Ngô Đồng through three caves, back to the same pier.

blocks.heading: The three caves
paragraphs: Tam Cốc means three caves. You board at the central pier, duck through the rock, and come back to the same landing. The caves are also called hang Ngoài or hang Lớn, hang Giữa or hang Trung, and hang Bé. Hang Cả is the long first cave: about 180 m, about 30 m wide, ceiling higher than 5 m, and also measured at 127 m with a mouth wider than 20 m. Hang Hai follows, about 90 m and also measured at 60 m, nearly 1 km on. Hang Ba is the last, more than 80 m and also measured at 50 m, with a ceiling under 3 m.
The boat turns at a temple near the last cave, đền Nội Lâm or đền Thần Nông. You can step off at bến Kẽm Gió and walk. Other landings on this water are Thung Nắng, Xuyên Thủy, and Thạch Bích.

blocks.heading: The combined ticket
paragraphs: Buy one ticket for the sampan, Đền Thái Vi, Động Tiên, and chùa Bích Động. Hotline 19009157. Take the electric shuttle between the stops, or stay on the boat and walk the 2 km to Bích Động and Thái Vi. Tràng An is a different ticket and a different river.

blocks.heading: Bích Động, Thái Vi, and the hamlet
paragraphs: Chùa Bích Động stands on núi Bích Động, 2 km from the pier: halls Hạ, Trung, and Thượng, a branch of sông Ngô Đồng, and the rice in front. It was formerly Bích Sơn. Sources date it to 1428, to the early Hậu Lê with an enlargement under Lê Hiển Tông (1740–1786), or to a Lê Trung Hưng founding by the monks Trí Kiên and Trí Thể. The “Bích Động” carving is dated 1774 and also 1773. Xuyên Thủy Động, the water cave through the hill, is about 350 m and is not on the combined ticket. Động Tiên, a dry cave of three chambers about 1 km from the pagoda, is on that ticket. Động Thiên Hương, also called Động Trời, is the cave on the walk to Thái Vi, with a shrine to Nguyễn Thị Sen.

Đền Thái Vi is a Nguyễn-style temple in the old Vũ Lâm base, one hall on 28 stone columns and a two-storey bell tower, a national historic relic since 1994. The altar names Trần Thái Tông and Trần Thánh Tông, and also Trần Hưng Đạo, Trần Quang Khải, and Trần Thị Dung. It is on the combined ticket.

Cố Viên Lầu is a yard of old houses, mostly from the Nguyễn period onward, collected in Ninh Bình and the Red River Delta, beside the pier and on the way to Thái Vi. The culture office added it to the site in 2008. It is not on the 2026 Tam Coc ticket. Làng thêu Văn Lâm is the stitch in the same hamlet, handbags and pictures beside the river.

blocks.heading: The other tickets
paragraphs: Thung Nắng is a second boat. Walk more than 500 m from bến Đình Các to bến Thạch Bích, then about 3 km by boat toward đền Thung Nắng and đền Vối. The afternoon is the time for white egrets. The scenic ticket is 20,000 đồng for an adult and 10,000 đồng for a child aged 6–15 or a person 60 and over. The boat is 160,000 đồng a trip, four people on a domestic boat and two on an international boat. Call Chị Phương on 0392232363. The Tam Coc ticket does not buy this boat.

Thung Nham is another valley, at thôn Hải Nham, with the bird garden at thôn Đam Khê, about 5 km west of chùa Bích Động. You climb động Vái Giời, 439 stone steps, about 5,000 m² on three levels, then the bird garden. The adult ticket is 250,000 đồng and a child from 1 m to 1.3 m is 150,000 đồng. That 250,000 đồng is not the Tam Coc fare. The electric car for the whole route is 40,000 đồng a person, and a child under 1 m rides free. The pool is 100,000 đồng for an adult and 50,000 đồng for a child from 1 m to 1.3 m. Phones 0912.900.887 and 0886.768.868.

Hang Bụt, Hang Chùa, and Hang Ghé share one ticket, Linh Cốc–Hải Nham. Hang Bụt sits in núi Tướng, thôn Hải Nham, 8 km from the Hoa Lư city centre and 1 km from chùa Bích Động, and the current visit is also in Sơn Hà. The cave runs nearly 500 m, with a stalactite compared to a Buddha, 1.5 m high and 2 m wide. The scenic ticket is 20,000 đồng for an adult and 10,000 đồng for a child aged 6–15 or a person 60 and over. The boat is 120,000 đồng a trip for an adult and 60,000 đồng for a child aged 6–15 or a person 60 and over, four people on a domestic boat and two on an international boat. Call Anh Chung on 0387584495. On that visit you cook the cá rô nướng, canh cua, and cà muối yourself. That meal is not a restaurant in thôn Văn Lâm.

cards.title: The three caves
cards.summary: Low rock, one sampan, and the bright mouth. About 2 hours out and back.

faqs.q: How long is the Tam Coc boat?
faqs.a: About 2 hours out and back, from Đình Các through the three caves and back to the same pier.

On 27 February 2026 an adult is 250,000 đồng without the shuttle and 350,000 đồng with it. A child from 1 m to 1.3 m is 120,000 đồng or 190,000 đồng. A 23 May 2023 line is 120,000 đồng a person a turn plus a boat at 150,000 đồng a trip, free under 3. A 2024 line is 120,000 đồng for an adult, 60,000 đồng for a child, and 150,000 đồng for the boat one way. The ticket covers Tam Cốc, Đền Thái Vi, Động Tiên, and chùa Bích Động.
In thôn Văn Lâm, at the pier, in the tourism-village cluster, or on the road toward Bích Động.

faqs.q: How do I get there from Hanoi?
faqs.a: SE7 leaves Hà Nội at 06:00 and reaches ga Ninh Bình at 08:16, 2 hours 16 minutes, at kilometre 115, or at 08:13. The pier is a further ride. The river is about 100 km by road from Hà Nội, and Hà Nội to Ninh Bình is also given as 94 km.

faqs.q: Is this the Trang An boat?
faqs.a: Tràng An is a different ticket and a different river, sông Sào Khê. Its listed property is 6,226 ha with a buffer of 6,026 ha; the 2014 decision lists 6,172 ha and a buffer of 6,079 ha. Hang Múa is its own ticket. Phố cổ Hoa Lư is about 15–20 minutes from Tam Coc.

season.label: Ripe rice at the end of May
season.note: The 2026 Sắc vàng festival opened on the morning of 24 May at Tam Cốc–Bích Động. The procession left the pier for Đền Thần Nông, with produce from 34 provinces, about 2,000 performers, and rice cut in the yellow field. It sits in the last days of May 2026, inside a tourism week of about 10 days. Next year’s solar date moves with the rice. The boat has no listed closed month.
